blocks.text: MIAMI — Unrivaled unveiled its rosters Tuesday night, with defending champion Breanna Stewart back with key members of Mist BC Arike Ogunbowale and Veronica Burton. The 3-on-3 league in its third season shapes its rosters through protections and the draft. Half of the eight-team league has players returning to a club Then coaches and the league office work together to complete each team on coaches input. The idea is always to build teams with complementary talent while still having competitive balance across the league.
